## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ConnectAnIntegrationToIcp`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `connect-runtime`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ConnectAnIntegrationToIcp**.

## Step 2: 1. Generate a secret

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Runtimes view for your target environment. Two entry points are available depending on whether the integration exists in ICP yet: -->
2. <!-- manual: Organization home: Click Runtimes in the sidebar. Use this when the integration does not exist in ICP yet. -->
3. <!-- manual: Project: Go to Projects › \ › Integrations › \ › Runtimes. Use this when the integration already exists. The generated snippet has project and integration pre-filled. -->
4. <!-- manual: Find the environment card (e.g. dev) and click Add Runtime. -->
5. Select **Generate Secret**. The **default profile** tab is selected by default.
6. <!-- manual: Copy the Config.toml snippet shown. -->
